purpose: This table is a small reference dataset mapping two-letter airline carrier codes to their full legal airline names, intended to feed joins from flight-level fact tables in downstream analytics.
usage: Consumers should join on the carrier column to enrich flight or booking records with a human-readable airline_name; the table is complete and unique per carrier so no filtering or deduplication is required before joining.
limitations: The table is tiny (16 rows) and fully populated with no nulls or duplicates found at profiling time (duplicate_row_rate 0.0, row_count 16), so no cleanup beyond dropping Airbyte capture metadata and renaming the ambiguous 'name' column was necessary; it does not capture carrier code changes or airline mergers over time.
